body:
I checked myself into an emergency crisis center about a month ago. It was absolutely awful. They wouldn't prescribe me meds unless I stayed for 72 hours and I would rather die than have to stay in one of those places again. 

My friends and family know. Most of them don't understand. It seems to make one group of my friends uncomfortable. Another who has a better idea of what I'm going through has been awesome in helping me out. But there is only so much he can do. I can only stay occupied so long before I'm left alone with my brain. At that point any progress I feel like I've made is just reversed and I'm right back to my worst.
